title: K3Ti2Cl9−xBrx: structurally stable lead-free perovskites as permissive absorbers for solar cell and visible-light photocatalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30233-30256
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01597B, Paper

The toxicity issues with lead-based perovskite solar cells sparked interest in lead-free alternatives, such as K3Ti2Cl9−xBrx (x = 0, 3, 6, and 9), which are environmentally friendly.
